svg.title: A sphere remembers the loop
svg.desc: An orthographic spherical octant connects the north pole with two equatorial points ninety degrees apart. The returned tangent arrow differs from the initial arrow. Great-circle transport around this octant rotates a tangent vector by 90°. Projection changes apparent angles on the page; the right angles and 90° rotation are intrinsic to the sphere.

svg.aria-label: A spherical octant has angle excess π/2.

g.text: The arrow never twists within its tangent plane.
